dialogue.english: Good, and I'm still studying engineering at university.

dialogue.speaker: Layna

dialogue.english: What year are you in now?

dialogue.speaker: Faisal
dialogue.arabic: في السنة الثالثة، وأدور تدريب صيفي.
dialogue.transliteration: fis-sana ith-thaliqa, w adoor tadreeb saifi.
dialogue.english: Third year, and I'm looking for a summer internship.

dialogue.speaker: Layna
dialogue.arabic: ممكن أسأل بالمستشفى، دايم يحتاجون متدربين.
dialogue.transliteration: mumkin as2al bil-mustashfa, daayim y7tajoon mitdarribeen.
dialogue.english: I can ask at the hospital, they always need trainees.

dialogue.speaker: Faisal
dialogue.arabic: الله يخليكي، هذا يفيدني كتير.
dialogue.transliteration: allah ykhalliki, hadha yfeedni kteer.
dialogue.english: God keep you, that would help me a lot.

dialogue.speaker: Layna

dialogue.transliteration: wala yhimmak, 7as2al bakra w agoolak.
dialogue.english: Don't worry, I'll ask tomorrow and tell you.

dialogue.speaker: Faisal
dialogue.arabic: تسلمي كتير.

dialogue.english: Thank you so much.

dialogue.speaker: Salem
dialogue.arabic: هلا نور، ليش شكلك تعبانة؟
dialogue.transliteration: hala noor, leesh shaklak ta3baana?
dialogue.english: Hi Noor, why do you look tired?

dialogue.speaker: Noor
dialogue.arabic: عندي امتحان بكرة وما فهمت المحاضرة كويس.
dialogue.transliteration: 3indi imti7aan bukra w ma fhimt il-mu7adara kwayyis.

dialogue.arabic: أي مادة؟

dialogue.english: Which subject?

dialogue.arabic: الكيمياء، والدكتور غايب اليوم، ما أقدر أسأله.
dialogue.transliteration: il-keemya2, wal-doktoor ghaayib il-yoom, ma agdar as2alah.
dialogue.english: Chemistry, and the professor is absent today, I can't ask him.

dialogue.speaker: Salem
dialogue.arabic: أنا عندي محاضرة الساعة تسع بكرة، بس أقدر أساعدك دحين.
dialogue.transliteration: ana 3indi mu7adara is-saa3a tis3a bukra, bas agdar asaa3dak dhin.
dialogue.english: I have a lecture at nine tomorrow, but I can help you now.

dialogue.speaker: Noor
dialogue.arabic: صدق؟ مشكور.
dialogue.transliteration: Sidg? mashkoor.
dialogue.english: Really? Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Salem
dialogue.arabic: بس لازم أسلم واجب قبل الجمعة، نروح المكتبة ندرس؟

dialogue.english: But I have to submit an assignment before Friday, shall we go to the library and study?

dialogue.speaker: Noor
dialogue.arabic: المكتبة مفتوحة لين الليل، تمام نروح.
dialogue.transliteration: il-maktaba maftoo7a lin il-layl, tamam nroo7.
dialogue.english: The library is open until night, okay let's go.

dialogue.speaker: Salem
dialogue.arabic: وأصحابنا يجوا معانا، كويسين مرة.
dialogue.transliteration: w as7abna yijoo ma3aana, kwayyiseen marra.
dialogue.english: And our friends will come with us, they are very nice.

dialogue.speaker: Noor
dialogue.arabic: إن شاء الله تطلع نتيجتي كويسة.
dialogue.transliteration: in shaa allah tiTla3 nateejti kwayyisa.
dialogue.english: God willing my result comes out good.

dialogue.speaker: Salem
dialogue.arabic: إن شاء الله، وأنا كمان.
dialogue.transliteration: in shaa allah, w ana ba3ad.
dialogue.english: God willing, and mine too.

dialogue.speaker: Rashid
dialogue.arabic: حصة، إيش ناوية تسوين بعد ما تتخرجين؟

dialogue.arabic: أبغى أكمل دراستي ماجستير، وبعدين أشتغل. وأنت؟

dialogue.speaker: Rashid
dialogue.arabic: أنا ناوي أفتح مشروعي الخاص، حلمي أفتح مطعم.
dialogue.transliteration: ana naawi iftah7 mashroo3i il-khaaS, hilmi iftah7 mat3am.
dialogue.english: I intend to start my own project, my dream is to open a restaurant.

dialogue.speaker: Hessa
dialogue.arabic: ما شاء الله! فين حتفتحه؟
dialogue.transliteration: ma shaa allah! feen 7atiftahuh?
dialogue.english: Wonderful! Where will you open it?

dialogue.speaker: Rashid
dialogue.arabic: يمكن بجدة، بس لسة ما قررت.
dialogue.transliteration: yimkin bi-jidda, bas lissa ma 2arrart.
dialogue.english: Maybe in Jeddah, but I haven't decided yet.

dialogue.speaker: Hessa
dialogue.arabic: وبعد خمس سنين فين حتكون إن شاء الله؟
dialogue.transliteration: w ba3d khams sneen feen 7atkoon in shaa allah?

dialogue.speaker: Rashid
dialogue.arabic: إن شاء الله يكون عندي كم فرع.
dialogue.transliteration: in shaa allah ykoon 3indi kam far3.
dialogue.english: God willing I'll have a few branches.

dialogue.speaker: Hessa
dialogue.arabic: الله يوفقك. أنا طموحي أصير دكتورة بالجامعة.
dialogue.transliteration: allah ywaffigak. ana tumoo7i aseer doktora bil-jam3a.

dialogue.speaker: Rashid

dialogue.speaker: Hessa

dialogue.transliteration: allah yislimak, w ahamm shai nirta7 fi shughulna.
dialogue.english: God keep you, and the most important thing is to be comfortable in our work.

dialogue.english: Peace be upon you, Mr Salem.

dialogue.english: How is Yousef doing at school?

lessons.culture: Saudi schools are separate for boys and girls and the week runs Sunday to Thursday. Pupils call a teacher يا أستاذ or يا أستاذة, the morning break is الفسحة, and the school day is الدوام, the same word adults use for working hours.

exercises.prompt: The teacher asks: "حلّيت الواجب؟" Say yes, you did it yesterday.

too_formal.feedback: أنجزته is written Arabic. Saudi pupils "solve" homework: حلّيته.

exercises.tip: Homework is something you حلّ, "solve", in Saudi speech.

exercises.prompt: A boy asks you: "الدوام متى يخلص؟" Say at half past one.

too_formal.feedback: This is how a timetable is written. Out loud: الساعة وحدة ونص.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "افتح كتابك على _____ عشرة." (Open your book to page ten.)
Complete: "اكتب الدرس على _____." (Write the lesson on the board.)
exercises.tip: سبّورة is the word for the classroom board.

exercises.prompt: Translate: "I forgot my pen."

too_formal.feedback: لقد is a written word; in speech the sentence starts with the verb.

exercises.prompt: Translate: "The teacher is in the classroom."

too_formal.feedback: Understood, but Saudi pupils say الأستاذ and call the classroom الفصل.

exercises.prompt: Translate: "Which grade are you in?" (to a boy)
exercises.tip: The answer names the year and the stage: خامس ابتدائي, تالت متوسّط.

exercises.prompt: What do Saudi pupils call the school break?
exercises.tip: الفسحة is the morning break when pupils eat and play.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence asks the teacher to go to the bathroom?
Put the words in order: "مجتهد / طالب / ولدي" (My son is a diligent student.)
exercises.tip: ولدي (waladi) is "my son" in everyday speech.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order: "المدرسة / لبس / تنسى / لا" (Don't forget the school uniform.)

too_formal.feedback: الزيّ المدرسي is the official name. At home parents say لبس المدرسة.

dialogue.english: Welcome, Karim, please have a seat.

dialogue.english: Thank you.

dialogue.arabic: شركتكم كبيرة ومعروفة، وأبغى أتعلّم منكم.
dialogue.transliteration: sharikatkum kabeera w ma3roofa, w abgha at3allam minkum.
dialogue.english: Your company is big and well known, and I want to learn from you.

response.english: My name is Karim, and I'm an engineer.

pair.english: How many years of experience do you have?

response.english: I'm organised and I learn quickly.

response.arabic: أقدر أبدأ من بكرة إن شاء الله.
response.transliteration: agdar abda min bukra in shaa2 allah.
response.english: I can start tomorrow, God willing.

lessons.culture: An interview in a Jeddah office usually opens with greetings and often a cup of coffee or tea before the questions start. It is held in polite everyday Hejazi rather than formal Arabic, and anything about the future, like a start date, gets an إن شاء الله.

exercises.prompt: The interviewer says: "عرّفنا على نفسك." Say your name is Karim and you are an engineer.

too_formal.feedback: Correct, but the -an ending and أعمل sound written. Spoken: وأنا مهندس.

exercises.prompt: The interviewer asks: "متى تقدر تبدأ؟" Say you can start tomorrow, God willing.
exercises.answer: أقدر أبدأ من بكرة إن شاء الله
accepted: أقدر أبدأ من بكرة إن شاء الله
agdar abda min bukra in shaa2 allah
اقدر ابدا من بكرة ان شاء الله
أقدر أبدأ بكرة إن شاء الله

too_formal.feedback: أستطيع and غدًا are written forms. Spoken Hejazi says أقدر and بكرة.

exercises.tip: Add إن شاء الله to anything about the future.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "كم سنة _____؟" (How many years of experience do you have?)
Complete: "حنكلّمك الأسبوع _____." (We will call you next week.)

too_formal.feedback: القادم is the written word for "next". In speech: الجاي.

exercises.tip: حـ before the verb makes the future: حنكلّمك, "we will call you".

exercises.prompt: Translate: "I graduated from the faculty of engineering."
Translate: "Why do you want to work with us?" (to a man)

too_formal.feedback: Every word here is written Arabic. Hejazi: ليش، تبغى، تشتغل، معانا.

exercises.prompt: Translate: "Thank you for your time." (to a man)

too_formal.feedback: Fine in an email. Face to face, مشكور على وقتك is the natural close.

exercises.tip: To a woman: مشكورة على وقتك.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence means "I work well with the team"?
Which word means "salary"?
Put the words in order: "الذاتية / سيرتي / دي" (This is my CV.)
Put the words in order: "عندك؟ / القوّة / إيش / نقاط" (What are your strengths?)

challenge.title: Talk About Your Work or Studies
challenge.instructions: اكتب واحك حوار قصير بالحجازي بـ 10 أسطر على الأقل عن شغلك أو دراستك وخططك للمستقبل. استخدم 8 عبارات من unit-08 على الأقل واشمل صيغة مذكر وصيغة مؤنث في الخطاب.
required_elements: سؤال عن المهنة بـ إيش تشتغل أو إيش تشتغلين.
جواب فيه تحديد المهنة أو المجال.
سؤال عن مكان الشغل أو الدراسة بـ فين.
ذكر سنين الخبرة أو السنة الدراسية.
خطة مستقبلية بـ أبغى أو ناوي أو حـ.
ذكر طموح أو حلم بـ طموحي أو حلمي.
جملة إن شاء الله بعد الخطة.
إغلاق بـ الله يوفقك أو ولا يهمك.

dialogue.speaker: فايز
dialogue.arabic: هلا لينا، إيش تشتغلين دحين؟
dialogue.transliteration: hala layna, eesh tishtaghleen dhin?
dialogue.english: Hi Layna, what do you do now?

dialogue.speaker: لينا
dialogue.arabic: أشتغل محامية في مكتب صغير، وإنت؟
dialogue.transliteration: ashtighul mu7amiya fi maktab Sagheer, w int?
dialogue.english: I work as a lawyer at a small office, and you?

dialogue.speaker: فايز
dialogue.arabic: أنا لسة أدرس الاقتصاد بالجامعة، في السنة الرابعة.
dialogue.transliteration: ana lissa adrus il-iqtiSaad bil-jam3a, fis-sana ir-raab3a.
dialogue.english: I'm still studying economics at university, in the fourth year.

dialogue.speaker: لينا
dialogue.arabic: ما شاء الله، وبعد ما تتخرج إيش ناوي تسوي؟
dialogue.transliteration: ma shaa allah, w ba3d ma titkhaarraj eesh naawi tisawwi?
dialogue.english: Wonderful, and after you graduate what do you plan to do?

dialogue.speaker: فايز
dialogue.arabic: أبغى أقدم على وظيفة في بنك، إن شاء الله ألقى شي كويس.
dialogue.transliteration: abgha agaddim 3ala wathiifa fi bank, in shaa allah alga shai kwayyis.
dialogue.english: I want to apply for a job at a bank, God willing I'll find something good.

dialogue.speaker: لينا
dialogue.arabic: إن شاء الله، وإيش طموحك؟
dialogue.transliteration: in shaa allah, w eesh tumoo7ak?
dialogue.english: God willing, and what is your ambition?

dialogue.speaker: فايز
dialogue.arabic: طموحي أصير مدير فرع يوم من الأيام.
dialogue.transliteration: tumoo7i aseer mudeer far3 yoom min il-ayyaam.
dialogue.english: My ambition is to become a branch manager one day.

dialogue.speaker: لينا
dialogue.arabic: كويس مرة، وأنا أبغى أكمل دراستي ماجستير في القانون.
dialogue.transliteration: kwayyis marra, w ana abgha akammil diraaste majesteer fil-qaanoon.
dialogue.english: Very nice, and I want to continue my studies for a master's in law.

dialogue.speaker: فايز
dialogue.arabic: الله يوفقك، أكيد حتوصلين.
dialogue.transliteration: allah ywaffigak, akeed 7atwaSaleen.
dialogue.english: God grant you success, you'll definitely get there.

dialogue.speaker: لينا
dialogue.arabic: الله يسلمك، وياليت توصل لهدفك بعد.
dialogue.transliteration: allah yislimak, w yaalait tooSal lihadafak ba3ad.
dialogue.english: God keep you, and I hope you reach your goal too.
